steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; wp_set_current_user(1); update_option('blogname','Rahul Fitness'); update_option('blogdescription','Phase-one design preview'); update_option('blog_public','0'); rf_preview_create(); $state = get_option('rf_preview_state'); if (count($state['pages']) !== 4) { throw new Exception('Expected four pages'); } foreach ($state['pages'] as $slug => $id) { wp_update_post(array('ID'=>$id,'post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>str_replace(' â€” Rahul Fitness preview','',get_the_title($id)))); } update_option('show_on_front','page'); update_option('page_on_front',$state['pages']['home']); update_option('elementor_active_kit',$state['global-styles']); global $wp_rewrite; $wp_rewrite->set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules(); $routes=rf_preview_routes($state); foreach($state['pages'] as $slug=>$id) { rf_preview_write_document($id,rf_preview_read($slug),$routes,'wp-page'); } foreach(array('shared-header','shared-footer') as $key) { rf_preview_write_document($state[$key],rf_preview_read($key),$routes,'section'); } \Elementor\Plugin::instance()->files_manager->clear_cache(); file_put_contents('/wordpress/.rahul-preview-ready','1'); echo 'Rahul Fitness: four native Elementor pages ready; '.ELEMENTOR_VERSION;
